question: How does cp-03 read a v1 DecisionRecorded as v2 without rewriting it?
diagram:
flowchart LR
  subgraph api["apps/api · PlanRoom DO"]
    ST[("SQLite · events · v1 rows")]
    RD["events() · read()"]
  end
  subgraph test["upcast.expect.test.ts"]
    V1["verbatim v1 stream"]
    SN["decision-recorded-v1-to-v2.snap.txt"]
  end
  subgraph dom["packages/domain"]
    UP["upcast(stream) · upcast/index.ts"]
    V2["DecisionRecorded v2 · rationale"]
    EV["evolve · project"]
  end
  ST -- "SELECT * ORDER BY version" --> RD
  RD -. "not wired at cp-03" .-> UP
  V1 -- "upcast(v1)" --> UP
  UP -- "rationale from the last reply" --> V2
  V2 -- "only v2 shapes" --> EV
  V2 -- "describeMessage" --> SN

steps.caption: The stored rows stay exactly as prod wrote them, with no rationale field.
A test feeds a verbatim v1 stream to the upcaster.
Each upcaster is one pure function, run on read.
A v1 DecisionRecorded gains a rationale taken from the last reply before it.
evolve and project only ever see the v2 shape.
The snapshot shows the recorded stream and the read stream side by side.
The Durable Object does not call upcast yet, so that edge stays dashed.
